meta.name: Thank You, Next
meta.description: After a painful breakup, a young lawyer dives head first into the confusing world of modern dating, with the unwavering support of her best friends.

videos.title: #Situationship
videos.overview: Newly single lawyer Leyla starts seeing Feyyaz, a chef she met while on vacation. At work, she takes on the divorce case of entrepreneur Cem Murathan.

videos.title: #Lovebombing
videos.overview: Leyla realizes there's more to Cem than his wife would have her believe. Her ex Ömer interrupts a lavish date with Feyyaz.

videos.title: #Ghosting
videos.overview: After Feyyaz ghosts her, Leyla takes steps to cut Ömer out of her life, leading him to file for custody of their dog Buddy.

videos.title: #Flashbacking vs fast forwarding
videos.overview: The divorce case is wrapped up, but Cem keeps his hooks in Leyla. A New Year's Eve party ends with a sudden trip to the hospital.

videos.title: #Benching
videos.overview: Cem hires Leyla's firm and asks her to represent him at a winery auction. She keeps her distance but finds herself drawn to him at his hotel's opening.

videos.title: #Crosschecking
videos.overview: Needing a break from everything, Leyla joins a family gathering where she discovers her parents' marriage isn't as happy as she'd thought.

videos.title: #Truthordare
videos.overview: Ömer works his way back into Leyla's life, culminating in a proposal. Leyla envisions a future with him but can't stop thinking about Cem.

videos.title: #Wedding
videos.overview: Leyla learns the truth about the men in her life — even as she's found her happy ending.

videos.title: #TakotsuboKardiyomiyopati
videos.overview: Leyla gets a fresh start when she finally moves into her new home, but Ömer's temper gets the better of him when he lashes out at one of his own friends.

videos.title: #FriendZone
videos.overview: Defne experiences a tragic loss and reaches out to Cem for help rather than Seyyaz, causing him to question their relationship's sincerity.

videos.title: #CatchMeIfYouCan
videos.overview: Nil catches Leyla and Cem in a compromising position, splashing their scandalous relationship all over the news. Beliz decides to file for a divorce.

videos.title: #MicroCheating
videos.overview: Sarp finds Ömer in a bad condition. Leyla begins to feel the worrying repercussions of being Cem Murathan's object of desire.

videos.title: #RingRing!
videos.overview: Murat spirals when he finds out about Esra's brief rendezvous with an old flame. Leyla takes an unexpected trip to visit her parents.

videos.title: #CloudNine
videos.overview: Beliz arrives at a New Year's Eve party with a surprise date, while Cem makes an unexpected gesture to get closer to Leyla.

videos.title: #TurningPoint
videos.overview: Defne's manipulation creates distance between Cem and Leyla, while Leyla feels increasingly out of place in her new home.

videos.title: #BungeeJumping
videos.overview: Cem's real motives emerge as jealousy strikes once more. Defne's role proves more complex than initially apparent.
